least_intrusive_reclamation_proposal.scope: Only the three pinned scientific runtime roots and already-read/hash-validated regular descriptors; no blind whole-Ubuntu export or unrelated files.
least_intrusive_reclamation_proposal.later_streaming_option: Apply the advisory only after each large immutable file fullSHA is established during a reviewed discovery adapter, preserving original scientific file-map identity.
least_intrusive_reclamation_proposal.evidence_required: Same-boot Linux before/after cache counters, Windows global commit/physical+VM/process private before/after; no claim of immediate host commit return from guest cache drop alone.
least_intrusive_reclamation_proposal.fallback: If targeted advice cannot establish enough headroom, preserve state and root reviews a separate bounded guest clean-pagecache action under broad explicit WSL authority. No automatic retry or reserve weakening.
